Yes, that's the "this word or that word" behavior I wanted. Typing "grid potatoes" and switching to "any word" pulled up both the CSS Grid link and the roast-potatoes one — two things that have nothing to do with each other, but I wanted either. And I like that it's a simple toggle: normally it wants everything to match, but I can flip it to "any" when I'm casting a wider net. No operators to remember, just a choice I can see.

So the "or" behavior works the way I expect. Happy with this.
